en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a rocky coastal bay with wooden bathhouse buildings on the shoreline. A large building with many windows stands on the rocks, with people gathered around in light summer clothing. A tall flagpole flies a Scandinavian-style cross flag with a line of small pennants. In the background are bare granite cliffs. The caption "HÖNÖ HAVSBAD" appears printed in white at the lower left, and a small publisher's logo with a number appears at the lower right.
